text: His lamp hangs on the cart in the yard. Bring it to me, and I will draw the bolt on the side door.
Someone is hurt, down there. Please, help them.
It begins again. Sometimes I hear them on the stairs.
Hush now. They go away if you do not answer them.
The carters came down this road for forty years. My Josef was the last. He went out to the yard for his lamp, and did not come back.
The road is shut with the snow, and with the other thing. Do not trust the road.
His lamp. Oh, Josef. Take the side door, it is yours for two rounds. I will not need it.
